scope: Transition inspector/timeline completion through the real route, plus Property-ramp projection before carrier removal
invariants: Cut is the absence of a Transition at exact integer adjacency; the derived junction projection mints no identity and a 1 ms gap offers none.
Insert ripples the incoming connected closure later by the duration exactly once per Clip; outgoing timing, unrelated Clips, Show End, Markers, Layout occurrences and Show-wide animation stay fixed.
A settings edit keeps Transition identity, endpoints, duration, whole-output window and Property ramps, and leaves every Clip time unchanged.
Reset to Cut deletes the Transition and moves incoming contributors and connected successors earlier by its duration only.

Surviving Transition propertyRamps are projected into independently activated tracks, retaining value, easing, activation interval and time mapping, before the visual carrier is removed by Clip deletion or Reset.
Identity is never allocated inside the pure owner: track, keyframe, Transition and participant identities come from explicit caller plans and refuse on conflict.
Refusal and no-op return the original record identity with empty affected collections and produce no preparation, history, timestamp or save.
Restart fires at first contribution: attaching or resizing an incoming Transition moves the trigger with the contribution window, not with the nominal Clip start.
partitions: junction scope: participant (one Zone/Layer) versus whole-output (every boundary contributor), exact adjacency versus 1 ms gap
Layer topology: Main Layer, overlay Layer, one Zone, two Zones, converging chain into a shared whole-output boundary
kinds: crossfade (live-live and snapshot-live), fade-color, wipe, dither, portal, motion
carrier targets: show-repeat-scale (projected), layout-occurrence-split-position (projected), clip-owned ramp on the deleted Clip (removed with its target), unprojectable target (refused)
delete plans: no carrier, exactly matching plans, missing plan, plan naming a retained Transition, projection the #1037 owner refuses
admission: malformed intent (extra field, Cut kind, nonpositive duration, caller-authored ramp), missing identity, inexact endpoints, compiler-ineligible, stale record/provider replacement
route lifetime: pending double submit, stale capture, failed save rollback and retry, obsolete completion
sequences: derived Cut -> Insert -> settings (kind change) -> existing duration resize -> Undo -> Redo -> Reset to Cut -> reload saved v2 -> page reload -> native artifact reopen
whole-output Insert across two Zones -> resize -> Reset, each contributor moved once
Cut -> Insert -> trailing resize of the outgoing Clip -> Reset, tracking the derived Restart event
two-Clip Show -> delete second Clip -> re-add at the exact boundary and at a 1 ms gap
carrier Transition -> Reset with derived projections -> reopened record; carrier Transition -> delete a contributor Clip with projection plans
oracles: Reopened .pxlshow v2 through parseProvisionalShowRecordV2 and the real file bundle importer; exact Clip start/duration, Transition settings, track values, easing and activation.
Real closed admission through the store: one prepareShowStageV2 call, one provider write, one history entry, exact affected collections, and provider readback of the persisted composition.
Fast and Precise fastReplay frames and exports at named times compared against an independently prepared expected record; identical generated artifact code.
deriveShowRestartEventsV2 event times before and after attach, resize and Reset.
Authenticated route: pre-registered successful PUT count with semantic readback after every visible action, plus captured Fast/Precise frames on the running Stage.
Zero-write refusal: RL08 compiler refusal surfaced in the route with no PUT and unchanged persisted bytes.
redEvidence: Clip deletion with a surviving carrier refused as unsupported-property-carrier before the projection owner was consumed (3 of 6 cases red).
Missing ShowV2TransitionEditor component and pilot mount (9 cases).
Converging-chain whole-output Insert first red on Show End overflow before the fixture reserved tail room.
faults: Removing the projection from the deletion candidate (use the preimage record) killed by 'projects a surviving global scalar ramp into an independently activated track'.
Removing the missing-plan guard killed by 'refuses atomically when a removed carrier has no projection plan'.
Changing the settings plan duration by one millisecond killed by the model and admission identity/timing cases.
Widening projected activation by one millisecond killed by the model and admission Reset activation cases.
Allowing a caller-authored ramp on an Insert intent killed by the admission 'authored ramp' partition.
residualGaps: Resizing a Transition that carries Property ramps stays an adapter-only refusal: no accepted ramp re-timing semantics exist, and the owner refuses atomically rather than guessing one.

Reset and delete projection planning covers only the two global scalar ramp targets that conversion produces and lowering accepts; any other ramp target refuses by name rather than inventing a destination value.

A projected layout-occurrence-split-position track whose activation would start before its owning occurrence refuses through the record validator; this is a representation limit of the occurrence-scoped activation rule, not a compiler limit.
RL08, RL09 and RL10 remain bounded compiler refusals and are surfaced unchanged; the route exercises RL08 as a real zero-write refusal.
The directed-cycle guard in the pure owner is unreachable from a validated record (a cycle cannot satisfy exact endpoint adjacency); reachable invalid topology is proved instead.
Continuous-flat participant Transitions with multiple Layouts keep their existing atomic refusal; this slice neither repairs nor widens it.
Final authoritative committed-tip suites and Fable High review remain coordinator-owned.
